profile.headline: Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase | UH ‘21 Alumna | B.S. Computer Science
profile.summary:
I currently work full time as a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase. 

I graduated from the University of Houston (May 2021) with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and a minor in Mathematics.

As an undergraduate student, I was an active member of various students organizations on campus (both in person and virtual) and also have held leadership positions for multiple organizations at the same time. 

I am the founding Vice President for the Cougarettes (the ACM-W chapter of UH) and was the Mentorship Chair for the Society of Women Engineers - UH Chapter (SWE - UH) (2020-2021), SWE - UH Membership Chair (2019-2020) and Director of HR for CodeRED Voyage (a hackathon run by CougarCS)(Jan 2020 - Nov 2020)

positions.title: Software Engineer I - Early Career Software Engineering Program
Founding Vice President
positions.description:
-Making flyers, slides and collaborating with the President to organize the very first team of officers for this new organization as well as outreach to new members.
-Introduced Marketing, Outreach and Event Planning Committees so that the organization runs smoothly.
-Determine the next set of officers for the next academic year 2021-2022 through interviews held by the Executive Board including 7 fellow officers.
-Hosted the Officer Transition Meeting where old officers handed over their duties and tasks to the new officers.

positions.title: Team Lead and Student Consultant
positions.description:
-Created a product website for a start up company.
-Created 8 Python tutorial videos and a supporting website for high school students including the script, exercises and an inbuilt Python compiler
-Served as Team Leader, created activity reports and the Statement of Work for the clients
-Used Azure DevOps and GitHub for organizing my team of 12 members and to assign tasks
-Got the Statement of Work signed by the client using DocuSign

positions.title: SWE-Pros Mentorship Chair
positions.description:
-The SWE-Pros Mentorship Program run by the Mentorship Chair allows upperclassmen members of the Society of Women Engineers-University of Houston chapter to be mentors to their respective lowerclassmen mentees based on their interests, hobbies and majors
- Tasks include assigning mentors to mentees throughout the year and determining the mentor-mentee pair that demonstrated the most participation on the program

positions.title: Mentor - SWE-Pros
positions.description:
2018-2020: SWE Pros Mentor to Freshman student majoring in Computer Science
2020-2021: SWE Pros Mentorship Chair and SWE Pros Mentor to Sophomore Computer Engineering and Freshman Computer Science students

positions.title: Membership Chair
positions.description:
-Assign and maintain Membership points to active members of the organization (around 400 members) for their participation in Society of Women Engineers’ General Meetings, Committee involvement and volunteering
-In charge of icebreakers at every SWE General Meeting
-Determine the most active member of the year, freshman of the year and most active committee members for internal scholarships

positions.title: Mentee - SWE-Pros
positions.description:
- Was assigned as a mentee to a Junior Chemical Engineering student who helped me perfect my resume, interview and professional skills during 2018-2019
- Mentee to a Senior Computer Engineering student who has had internship experience with Boeing and helped me perfect my resume, LinkedIn and also helped me develop my interpersonal skills during 2019-2020

positions.title: Peer Mentor - Computer Architecture and Organization
positions.description: Guide and help students struggling in Computer Architecture and Organization concepts.

company.name: University of Houston Natural Sciences & Mathematics

positions.title: CodeRed - Director of HR committee
positions.description:
- Director of Human Resources for the CodeRed - Voyage (Hackathon) held on November 7th-8th 2020
- In charge of Judge and Mentor sign up

positions.title: Lead Mentor - Summer Coding Camp
positions.locationName: HPE Data Science Institute at UH
positions.description: Lead Mentor for Girls Coding Academy’s Summer Camp 2020. I was assigned to mentor wonderful students from 6th grade.

positions.title: Co-Mentor - Summer Coding Camp
positions.description: Co-Mentor during the iTECH STEM Summer Camp 2020. I was assigned to mentor 3rd and 4th grade students.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Academic Support Assistant for ENGI 1100 students to provide a helping hand during classroom activities and projects during the class period.
- Host offices hours for ENGI 1100 students where they can ask questions related to coursework/project.
